mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, title, description, cover_url AS coverUrl FROM ff_topic WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_num ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, keyword, title, description, cover_url AS coverUrl FROM ff_topic WHERE id = #{topicId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, keyword, title, description, cover_url AS coverUrl FROM ff_topic WHERE status = 1 AND keyword = #{keyword} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, keyword, title, description, cover_url AS coverUrl FROM ff_topic WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ff_game_session( user_id, current_topic_id, current_keyword, score, correct_count, wrong_count, skip_count, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{currentTopicId}, #{currentKeyword}, #{score}, #{correctCount}, #{wrongCount}, #{skipCount}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, current_topic_id AS currentTopicId, current_keyword AS currentKeyword, score, correct_count AS correctCount, wrong_count AS wrongCount, skip_count AS skipCount, status, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ff_game_session WHERE id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ff_game_session SET current_topic_id = #{topicId}, current_keyword = #{keyword}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE ff_game_session SET score = #{score}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, wrong_count = #{wrongCount}, skip_count = #{skipCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, sentence, sentence_clean AS sentenceClean, poem_title AS poemTitle, author, dynasty, source_text AS sourceText, difficulty FROM ff_sentence WHERE is_active = 1 AND keyword = #{keyword} ORDER BY difficulty ASC, id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT id, keyword, sentence, sentence_clean AS sentenceClean, poem_title AS poemTitle, author, dynasty, source_text AS sourceText, difficulty FROM ff_sentence WHERE is_active = 1 AND keyword = #{keyword} ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1

SELECT id, keyword, sentence, sentence_clean AS sentenceClean, poem_title AS poemTitle, author, dynasty, source_text AS sourceText, difficulty FROM ff_sentence WHERE is_active = 1 AND keyword = #{keyword} AND sentence_clean = #{sentenceClean} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ff_game_answer( session_id, user_id, topic_id, keyword, user_sentence, user_sentence_clean, matched_sentence_id, is_correct, score_award, hint_used ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{topicId}, #{keyword}, #{userSentence}, #{userSentenceClean}, #{matchedSentenceId}, #{isCorrect}, #{scoreAward}, #{hintUsed} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, COALESCE(SUM(a.score_award), 0) AS totalScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN ff_game_answer a ON a.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_url ORDER BY totalScore DESC, correctCount DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, keyword, sentence, sentence_clean AS sentenceClean, poem_title AS poemTitle, author, dynasty, source_text AS sourceText, difficulty FROM ff_sentence WHERE is_active = 1 AND ( sentence LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR poem_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR keyword LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ) ORDER BY difficulty ASC, id ASC LIMIT 20
